```python
def _render_ordered_list(renderer: 'BaseRenderer', token: Dict[str, Any],
    state: 'BlockState') ->Iterable[str]:
    start = token.get('start', 1)
    for i, item in enumerate(token['children'], start=start):
        parent = {
            'leading': str(i) + '. ',
            'tight': token['tight'],
        }
        yield _render_list_item(renderer, parent, item, state)
```
